name: Working Theory Farm Youth Positions
what_you_do: Youth employees work on a farm that grows food for community members. The page does not list the daily tasks.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 24. Many of the youth in the farm programs come from Latino and Latine backgrounds.
pay_detail: Youth earn income. The hourly rate is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: This season's youth applications are closed. The page says to check back in late January 2027.
how_to_apply: Check the Hiring page in late January 2027 and sign up for the farm newsletter to hear about postings.
notes: The page does not give the season dates or pay. Confirm both when applications open.
